description: Independent GenomeSpy visualization demo based on processed Mouse Cancer Cell Line Atlas data.
This starter view shows cell line annotations, mm10 cytobands, segmented copy ratios, and somatic mutations on canonical mm10 chromosomes only.
Alternative contigs, decoys, and other non-canonical sequence names are excluded during data wrangling.
The copy-number values are source LOG2FC values. They are not purified copy numbers and should be interpreted as copy-ratio segments.
The mutation track does not use semantic scoring. It is intended as a basic atlas-scale context layer and as a testbed for GenomeSpy Agent descriptions.
